name: m-arena
description: m-arena is a multilingual evaluation suite for reward/preference modelling that measures how well models capture human preferences across multiple languages. It provides paired responses or preference annotations in different languages to evaluate cross-lingual consistency and alignment of reward models. Useful for assessing multilingual preference prediction and ranking.
reputation: An emerging multilingual reward benchmark hosted on Hugging Face, increasingly referenced in work on cross-lingual preference modeling.
